x: Mawlānā Shaykh Nāẓim al-Ḥaqqānī · d. 2014 CE
The conveyance of reward along the whole chain — to the Prophet ﷺ, the Companions, the prophets, the four Imāms, the Khwājagān and the shaykhs of the ṭarīqa — closing on the prayer for rain.
سُبْحَانَ رَبِّـيَ الْعَلِيِّ الْأَعْلَى الْوَهَّابِ
Subḥāna Rabbiya l-ʿAliyyi l-Aʿlā l-Wahhāb
Glory be to my Lord, the Most High, the Exalted, the Bestower.
بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
Bismi llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm
In the name of Allāh, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful.
يَا رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ، حَمْدًا دَائِمًا مَّعَ خُلُوْدِكَ، سُبْحَانَكَ لَا نُحْصِيْ ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ، أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِكَ.
Yā Rabbanā laka l-ḥamd, ḥamdan dāʾiman maʿa khulūdik. Subḥānaka lā nuḥṣī thanāʾan ʿalayk; anta kamā athnayta ʿalā nafsik.
O our Lord, to You be praise — a praise enduring with Your everlastingness. Glory be to You: we cannot number the praise due to You; You are as You have praised Yourself.

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، اَلْفَاتِحِ لِمَا أُغْلِقَ، وَالْخَاتِمِ لِمَا سَبَقَ، نَاصِرِ الْحَقِّ بِالْحَقِّ، وَالْهَادِيْ إِلَـىٰ صِرَاطِكَ الْمُسْتَقِيْمِ، وَعَلَىٰ آلِهِ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَمِقْدَارِهِ الْعَظِيْمِ.

Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin, al-fātiḥi li-mā ughliq, wa l-khātimi li-mā sabaq, nāṣiri l-ḥaqqi bi-l-ḥaqq, wa l-hādī ilā ṣirāṭika l-mustaqīm; wa ʿalā ālihi ḥaqqa qadrihi wa miqdārihi l-ʿaẓīm.

O Allāh, bless our master Muḥammad — the opener of what was closed, the seal of what went before, the helper of truth by the truth, the guide to Your straight path — and his family, according to the true measure of his worth and his immense rank.

اَللّٰهُمَّ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ، اَللّٰهُمَّ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ، اَللّٰهُمَّ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ، يَا أَمَانَ الْخَائِفِيْنَ، يَا رَجَاءَ السَّائِلِيْنَ، يَا رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ.
Allāhumma yā Arḥama r-rāḥimīn, Allāhumma yā Arḥama r-rāḥimīn, Allāhumma yā Arḥama r-rāḥimīn; yā Amāna l-khāʾifīn, yā Rajāʾa s-sāʾilīn, yā Rabbanā wa Rabba kulli shayʾ.
O Allāh, O Most Merciful of those who show mercy — three times. O Safety of the fearful, O Hope of those who ask, O our Lord and Lord of all things.
رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ، وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْمُ،
Rabbanā taqabbal minnā innaka anta s-Samīʿu l-ʿAlīm; wa tub ʿalaynā yā Mawlānā innaka anta t-Tawwābu r-Raḥīm,
Our Lord, accept from us; You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. And turn to us, O our Master; You are the Ever-Relenting, the Merciful,
وَاهْدِنَا وَوَفِّقْنَا إِلَى الْحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ طَرِيْقٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ، بِبَرَكَةِ خَتْمِ الْقُرْآنِ الْعَظِيْمِ،
wa hdinā wa waffiqnā ilā l-ḥaqqi wa ilā ṭarīqin mustaqīm, bi-barakati khatmi l-Qurʾāni l-ʿaẓīm,
and guide us and grant us success toward the truth and toward a straight path, by the blessing of the completion of the mighty Qurʾān,
بِبَرَكَةِ مَوْلِدِ نَبِيِّنَا الْكَرِيْمِ، وَبِحُرْمَةِ مَنْ أَرْسَلْتَهُ رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِيْنَ، وَاعْفُ عَنَّا يَا كَرِيْمُ،
bi-barakati mawlidi nabiyyinā l-karīm, wa bi-ḥurmati man arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn; wa ʿfu ʿannā yā Karīm,
by the blessing of the birth of our noble Prophet, and by the sanctity of him whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds; and pardon us, O Generous One,
وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا بِفَضْلِكَ وَجُوْدِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ يَا أَكْرَمَ الْأَكْرَمِيْنَ، وَيَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ،
wa ghfir lanā dhunūbanā bi-faḍlika wa jūdika wa karamika, yā Akrama l-akramīn, wa yā Arḥama r-rāḥimīn,
and forgive us our sins by Your grace, Your bounty and Your generosity, O Most Generous of the generous, O Most Merciful of those who show mercy,
آمِيْنَ .اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ بِجَاهِ نَبِيِّكَ الْكَرِيْمِ، وَبِجَاهِ الْقُرْآنِ الْعَظِيْمِ، أَنْ تَرْزُقَنَا إِيْمَانًا كَامِلًا،
āmīn. Allāhumma innā nasʾaluka bi-jāhi nabiyyika l-karīm, wa bi-jāhi l-Qurʾāni l-ʿaẓīm, an tarzuqanā īmānan kāmilan,
āmīn. O Allāh, we ask You by the standing of Your noble Prophet and by the standing of the mighty Qurʾān that You grant us a complete faith,
وَيَقِيْنًا صَادِقًا، وَقَلْبًا خَاشِعًا، وَلِسَانًا ذَاكِرًا، وَرِزْقًا وَّاسِعًا، وَحَلَالًا طَيِّبًا، وَنُوْرًا سَاطِعًا،
wa yaqīnan ṣādiqan, wa qalban khāshiʿan, wa lisānan dhākiran, wa rizqan wāsiʿan, wa ḥalālan ṭayyiban, wa nūran sāṭiʿan,
and a true certainty, a humble heart, a tongue given to remembrance, ample provision, lawful and wholesome sustenance, a radiant light,
وَأَوْلَادً صَالِحًا، وَعَمَلًا صَالِحًا مَّقْبُوْلًا، وَتِجَارَةً لَّنْ تَبُوْرَ، يَا نُوْرَ النُّوْرِ، يَا عَالِمَ مَا فِى الصُّدُوْرِ،
wa awlādan ṣāliḥan, wa ʿamalan ṣāliḥan maqbūlan, wa tijāratan lan tabūr. Yā Nūra n-nūr, yā ʿĀlima mā fī ṣ-ṣudūr,
righteous children, righteous deeds accepted, and a commerce that will never fail. O Light of light, O Knower of what is within the breasts,
أَخْرِجْنَا يَا اَللّٰهُ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّوْرِ، وَنَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبَّنَا تَوْبَةً نَّصُوْحَةً، وَتَوْبَةً قَبْلَ الْمَوْتِ،
akhrijnā yā Allāhu mina ẓ-ẓulumāti ilā n-nūr. Wa nasʾaluka yā Rabbanā tawbatan naṣūḥatan, wa tawbatan qabla l-mawt,
bring us out, O Allāh, from the darknesses into the light. And we ask You, our Lord, for a sincere repentance, and repentance before death,
وَرَاحَةً عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ، وَمَغْفِرَةً وَّرَحْمَةًۢ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ، وَالْعَفْوَ عِنْدَ الْحِسَابِ، وَالْفَوْزَ بِالْجَنَّةِ،
wa rāḥatan ʿinda l-mawt, wa maghfiratan wa raḥmatan baʿda l-mawt, wa l-ʿafwa ʿinda l-ḥisāb, wa l-fawza bi-l-jannah,
and rest at death, and forgiveness and mercy after death, and pardon at the reckoning, and triumph with the Garden,
وَالنَّجَاةَ مِنَ النَّارِ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا عَزِيْزُ يَا غَفَّارُ، يَا كَرِيْمُ يَا سَتَّارُ .اَللّٰهُمَّ بَلِّغْ وَأَوْصِلْ ثَوَابَ مَا قَرَأْنَاهُ،
wa n-najāta mina n-nār, bi-raḥmatika yā ʿAzīzu yā Ghaffār, yā Karīmu yā Sattār. Allāhumma balligh wa awṣil thawāba mā qaraʾnāh,
and deliverance from the Fire, by Your mercy, O Mighty, O Ever-Forgiving, O Generous, O Veiler. O Allāh, convey and deliver the reward of what we have recited,
وَشَرَفَ مَا تَلَوْنَاهُ، بَعْدَ الْقَبُوْلِ مِنَّا، هَدِيَّةً وَّاصِلَةً، إِلَىٰ حَضْرَةِ حَبِيْبِكَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ سَيِّدِ الْأَوَّلِيْنَ وَالْآخِرِيْنَ،
wa sharafa mā talawnāh, baʿda l-qabūli minnā, hadiyyatan wāṣilatan ilā ḥaḍrati ḥabībika sayyidinā Muḥammadin, sayyidi l-awwalīna wa l-ākhirīn,
and the honour of what we have read — after accepting it from us — as a gift arriving at the presence of Your beloved, our master Muḥammad, master of the first and the last,
أَرْسَلْتَهُ رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِيْنَ وَشَفِيْعًا لِّلْمُذْنِبِيْنَ، ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ أَرْوَاحِ آلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ الْكِرَامِ،
arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīna wa shafīʿan li-l-mudhnibīn; thumma ilā arwāḥi ālihi wa aṣḥābihi l-kirām,
whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds and an intercessor for the sinful; then to the souls of his family and his noble Companions,
رِضْوَانُ اللّٰهِ تَعَالَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِيْنَ، ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ أَرْوَاحِ إِخْوَانِهِ مِنَ الْأَنْۢبِيَاءِ وَالْمُرْسَلِيْنَ،
riḍwānu llāhi taʿālā ʿalayhim ajmaʿīn; thumma ilā arwāḥi ikhwānihi mina l-anbiyāʾi wa l-mursalīn,
the good pleasure of Allāh Most High be upon them all; then to the souls of his brethren among the prophets and messengers,
صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهِ وَسَلَامُهُ عَلَىٰ نَبِيِّنَا وَعَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِيْنَ، وَإِلَىٰ أَرْوَاحِ خُدَمَاءِ شَرَائِعِهِمْ،
ṣalawātu llāhi wa salāmuhu ʿalā nabiyyinā wa ʿalayhim ajmaʿīn; wa ilā arwāḥi khudamāʾi sharāʾiʿihim,
the blessings and peace of Allāh upon our Prophet and upon them all; and to the souls of those who served their sacred laws,
ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ أَرْوَاحِ الْأَئِمَّةِ الْأَرْبَعَةِ الْمُجْتَهِدِيْنَ، أَعْلَامُ الدِّيْنَ، وَإِلَىٰ أَرْوَاحِ مَشَايِخِنَا فِى الطَّرِيْقَةِ النَّقْشِبَنْدِيَّةِ الْعَلِيَّةِ،
thumma ilā arwāḥi l-aʾimmati l-arbaʿati l-mujtahidīn, aʿlāmi d-dīn; wa ilā arwāḥi mashāyikhinā fī ṭ-ṭarīqati n-Naqshbandiyyati l-ʿaliyyah,
then to the souls of the four founding Imāms, the standards of the religion; and to the souls of our shaykhs in the exalted Naqshbandī way,
وَإِلَىٰ أَرْوَاحِ سَائِرِ سَادَاتِنَا، وَإِلَىٰ أَرْوَاحِ أَهْلِ الْخَوَاجَكَانِ، خَاصَّةً إِلَىٰ رُوْحِ إِمَامِ الطَّرِيْقَةِ وَغَوْثِ الْخَلِيْقَةِ،
wa ilā arwāḥi sāʾiri sādātinā, wa ilā arwāḥi ahli l-Khwājagān, khāṣṣatan ilā rūḥi imāmi ṭ-ṭarīqati wa ghawthi l-khalīqah,
and to the souls of all our masters, and to the souls of the people of the Khwājagān — and especially to the soul of the Imām of the way and the succour of creation,
خَوَاجَه بَهَاءُ الدِّيْنِ النَّقْشِبَنْدِ مُحَمَّدِ الْأُوَيْسِيِّ الْبُخَارِيْ، حَضْرَةِ أُسْتَاذِنَا سُلْطَانِ الْأَوْلِيَاءِ عَبْدُ اللّٰهِ دَاغِسْتَانِـيْ،
Khwāja Bahāʾuddīn an-Naqshband Muḥammadin al-Uwaysiyyi l-Bukhārī; ḥaḍrati ustādhinā sulṭāni l-awliyāʾ ʿAbdullāh ad-Dāghestānī,
Khwāja Bahāʾuddīn Naqshband Muḥammad al-Uwaysī al-Bukhārī; and the presence of our teacher, the Sultan of the Friends of God, ʿAbdullāh ad-Dāghestānī,

وَإِلَىٰ أَرْوَاحِ آبَائِنَا وَأُمَّهَاتِنَا وَأَبْنَائِنَا وَبَنَاتِنَا وَإِخْوَانِنَا وَأَخَوَاتِنَا وَأَجْدَادِنَا وَجَدَّاتِنَا وَأَعْمَامِنَا وَعَمَّاتِنَا وَأَخْوَالِنَا وَخَالَاتِنَا وَجَمِيْعِ شُهَدَائِنَا وَغُرَبَائِنَا وَالْمَظْلُمِيْنَ وَالسَّادَاتِ وَالشُّرَفَاءِ،

wa ilā arwāḥi ābāʾinā wa ummahātinā wa abnāʾinā wa banātinā wa ikhwāninā wa akhawātinā wa ajdādinā wa jaddātinā wa aʿmāminā wa ʿammātinā wa akhwālinā wa khālātinā, wa jamīʿi shuhadāʾinā wa ghurabāʾinā wa l-maẓlūmīna wa s-sādāti wa sh-shurafāʾ,

and to the souls of our fathers and mothers, our sons and daughters, our brothers and sisters, our grandfathers and grandmothers, our paternal uncles and aunts, our maternal uncles and aunts, and all our martyrs and strangers and the wronged, and the sayyids and the sharīfs,
وَعُمَّ بِكَرَمِكَ سَائِرَ أَمْوَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْمُسْلِمِيْنَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ مَا بَيْنَ الْمَشَارِقِ وَالْمَغَارِبِ عَامَّةً أَجْمَعِيْنَ،
wa ʿumma bi-karamika sāʾira amwāti l-muʾminīna wa l-muʾmināti wa l-muslimīna wa l-muslimāti mā bayna l-mashāriqi wa l-maghāribi ʿāmmatan ajmaʿīn,
and include by Your generosity all the departed among the believing men and women and the Muslim men and women, between the easts and the wests, all of them together,

وَإِلَىٰ أَرْوَاحِ أَهْلِ الْعَبَاءِ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِنَا وَالصِّدِّيْقِيُّوْنَ. اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِـيْ ذُنُوْبِـيْ وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِـيْ صَغِيْرًا .وَلِجَمِيْعِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْمُسْلِمِيْنَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ،

wa ilā arwāḥi ahli l-ʿabāʾi wa ahli baytinā wa ṣ-ṣiddīqiyyūn. Allāhumma ghfir lī dhunūbī wa li-wālidayya wa rḥamhumā kamā rabbayānī ṣaghīran; wa li-jamīʿi l-muʾminīna wa l-muʾmināti wa l-muslimīna wa l-muslimāt,

and to the souls of the People of the Cloak and the people of our house and the truthful ones. O Allāh, forgive me my sins and my parents, and have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small; and all the believing men and women and the Muslim men and women,
اَلْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ، وَتَابِعْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ بِالْخَيْرَاتِ، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرٌ رَّاحِمِيْنَ،
al-aḥyāʾi minhum wa l-amwāt; wa tābiʿ baynanā wa baynahum bi-l-khayrāt. Rabbi ghfir wa rḥam wa anta khayru r-rāḥimīn,
the living among them and the dead; and let good things pass continually between us and them. My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of those who show mercy,

وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِيْنَ سَبَقُوْنَا بِالْإِيْمَانِ، وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِىْ قُلُوْبِنَا غِلًّ لِّلَّذِيْنَ آمَنُوْا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَؤُوْفٌ رَّحِيْمٌ .اَللّٰهُمَّ أَيِّدِ الْإِسْلَامَ وَالْمُسْلِمِيْنَ،
wa ghfir lanā wa li-ikhwāninā lladhīna sabaqūnā bi-l-īmān, wa lā tajʿal fī qulūbinā ghillan li-lladhīna āmanū; rabbanā innaka Raʾūfun Raḥīm. Allāhumma ayyidi l-Islāma wa l-muslimīn,

and forgive us and our brethren who preceded us in faith, and put no rancour in our hearts toward those who believe; our Lord, You are Most Kind, Most Merciful. O Allāh, strengthen Islam and the Muslims,
وَأَعْلِ كَلِمَةَ الْحَقِّ وَالْمُوَاحِّدِيْنَ، بِإِظْهَارِ خَلِيْفَةِ اللّٰهِ الْمَهْدِيْ. اَللّٰهُمَّ انْصُرْهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيْزًا، وَافْتَحْ لَهُ فَتْحًا قَرِيْبًا.
wa aʿli kalimata l-ḥaqqi wa l-muwaḥḥidīn, bi-iẓhāri khalīfati llāhi l-Mahdī. Allāhumma nṣurhu naṣran ʿazīzan, wa ftaḥ lahu fatḥan qarīban.
and raise high the word of truth and of those who affirm His oneness, by the appearance of the vicegerent of Allāh, al-Mahdī. O Allāh, give him a mighty victory and grant him a near opening.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لَّنَا مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ وَلِيًّا. اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لَّنَا مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ سُلْطَانًا نَّصِيْرًا.
Allāhumma jʿal lanā min ladunka waliyyan. Allāhumma jʿal lanā min ladunka sulṭānan naṣīran.
O Allāh, appoint for us from Your presence a protector. O Allāh, appoint for us from Your presence a helping authority.
اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَنَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسْلِ، وَنَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ،
Allāhumma innā naʿūdhu bika mina l-hammi wa l-ḥazan, wa naʿūdhu bika mina l-ʿajzi wa l-kasal, wa naʿūdhu bika mina l-jubni wa l-bukhl,
O Allāh, we take refuge in You from anxiety and grief; and we take refuge in You from incapacity and idleness; and we take refuge in You from cowardice and miserliness,
وَنَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ، وَنَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيْحِ الدَّجَّالِ،
wa naʿūdhu bika min ghalabati d-dayni wa qahri r-rijāl, wa naʿūdhu bika min fitnati l-Masīḥi d-Dajjāl,
and we take refuge in You from being overwhelmed by debt and overpowered by men; and we take refuge in You from the trial of the false messiah,

وَنَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَهْدِ الْبَلَاءِ، وَدَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ، وَسُوْءِ الْقَضَاءِ، وَشَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ، بِحُرْمَةِ مَنْ أَرْسَلْتَهُ رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِيْنَ.اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّسَلِّمْ،

wa naʿūdhu bika min jahdi l-balāʾ, wa daraki sh-shaqāʾ, wa sūʾi l-qaḍāʾ, wa shamātati l-aʿdāʾ — bi-ḥurmati man arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn. Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammadin wa sallim,

and we take refuge in You from the rigour of affliction, from being overtaken by wretchedness, from an evil decree, and from the gloating of enemies — by the sanctity of him whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds. O Allāh, bless Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad and grant them peace,
صَلَاةً تُنْجِيْنَا بِهَا مِنْ جَمِيْعِ الْأَهْوَالِ وَالْآفَاتِ، وَتَقْضِيْ لَنَا بِهَا جَمِيْعَ الْحَاجَاتِ،
ṣalātan tunjīnā bihā min jamīʿi l-ahwāli wa l-āfāt, wa taqḍī lanā bihā jamīʿa l-ḥājāt,
a blessing by which You deliver us from all terrors and afflictions, and by which You settle for us all our needs,
وَتُطَهِّرُنَا بِهَا مِنْ جَمِيْعِ السَّيِّئَاتِ، وَتَرْفَعُنَا بِهَا أَعْلَى الدَّرَجَاتِ، وَتُبَلِّغُنَا بِهَا أَقْصَى الْغَايَاتِ،
wa tuṭahhirunā bihā min jamīʿi s-sayyiʾāt, wa tarfaʿunā bihā aʿlā d-darajāt, wa tuballighunā bihā aqṣā l-ghāyāt,
and by which You purify us of all evil deeds, and raise us by it to the highest degrees, and bring us by it to the furthest goals,
مِنْ جَمِيْعِ الْخَيْرَاتِ فِى الْحَيَاةِ وَبَعْدَ الْمَمَاتِ .اَللّٰهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ أُمَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِأُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
min jamīʿi l-khayrāti fī l-ḥayāti wa baʿda l-mamāt. Allāhumma aṣliḥ ummata Muḥammad; Allāhumma ghfir li-ummati Muḥammad,
of all good things, in life and after death. O Allāh, set right the community of Muḥammad; O Allāh, forgive the community of Muḥammad,

اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْحَمْ أُمَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ، اَللّٰهُمَّ احْفَظْ أُمَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ. يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ إِرْحَمْنَا، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ فَاعْفُ عَنَّا، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ، يَا غَفَّارَ الذُّنُوْبِ، وَيَا قَدِيْمَ الْإِحْسَانِ، وَيَا مُحْيِ الْعِظَامِ، وَيَا سَتَّارَ الْعُيُوْبِ، وَيَا فَتَّاحَ الْقُلُوْبِ.

Allāhumma rḥam ummata Muḥammad; Allāhumma ḥfaẓ ummata Muḥammadin ﷺ. Yā Arḥama r-rāḥimīna irḥamnā, yā Arḥama r-rāḥimīna fa-ʿfu ʿannā, yā Arḥama r-rāḥimīn; yā Ghaffāra dh-dhunūb, wa yā Qadīma l-iḥsān, wa yā Muḥyiya l-ʿiẓām, wa yā Sattāra l-ʿuyūb, wa yā Fattāḥa l-qulūb.

O Allāh, have mercy on the community of Muḥammad; O Allāh, protect the community of Muḥammad ﷺ. O Most Merciful of those who show mercy, have mercy on us; O Most Merciful, pardon us; O Most Merciful. O Forgiver of sins, O You whose beneficence is without beginning, O Reviver of bones, O Veiler of faults, O Opener of hearts.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثًا مُّغِيْثًا هَنِيْئًا مَّرِيْئًا مُّرِيْعًا، سَحًّا عَامًّا طَبَقًا دَائِمًا. اَللّٰهُمَّ اسْقِنَا الْغَيْثَ وَلَا تَجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الْقَانِطِيْنَ.
Allāhumma sqinā ghaythan mughīthan hanīʾan marīʾan murīʿan, saḥḥan ʿāmman ṭabaqan dāʾiman. Allāhumma sqinā l-ghaytha wa lā tajʿalnā mina l-qāniṭīn.
O Allāh, give us rain that rescues, wholesome, sweet and abundant — pouring, general, covering and lasting. O Allāh, give us the rain and do not make us of those who despair.

اَللّٰهُمَّ أَنْۢبِتْ لَنَا الزَّرْعَ وَأَدِرَّ لَنَا الضَّرْعَ وَاسْقِنَا مِنْۢ بَرَكَاتِ السَّمَاءِ، وَ أَنْۢبِتْ لَنَا مِنْۢ بَرَكَاتِ الْأَرْضِ .يَا مُغِيْثُ أَغِثْنَا، يَا مُغِيْثُ أَغِثْنَا، يَا مُغِيْثُ أَغِثْنَا.
Allāhumma anbit lanā z-zarʿa wa adirra lanā ḍ-ḍarʿa, wa sqinā min barakāti s-samāʾ, wa anbit lanā min barakāti l-arḍ. Yā Mughīthu aghithnā, yā Mughīthu aghithnā, yā Mughīthu aghithnā.

O Allāh, bring forth for us the crop and make the udder flow for us; give us to drink of the blessings of the sky, and bring forth for us of the blessings of the earth. O Rescuer, rescue us — three times.
اِسْتَجِبْ دُعَائَنَا وَتَضَرُّعَنَا، وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ يُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوْا، وَيَنْشُرُ رَحْمَتَهُ، وَهُوَ الْوَلِـيُّ الْحَمِيْدُ.
Istajib duʿāʾanā wa taḍarruʿanā. Wa huwa lladhī yunazzilu l-ghaytha min baʿdi mā qanaṭū, wa yanshuru raḥmatah, wa huwa l-Waliyyu l-Ḥamīd.
Answer our supplication and our pleading. He it is who sends down the rain after they have despaired, and spreads out His mercy; and He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy.
وَإِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُوْنَ، فَالْحُكْمُ لِلّٰهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْكَبِيْرِ، وَحَسْبُنَا اللّٰهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ،
Wa innā li-llāhi wa innā ilayhi rājiʿūn. Fa-l-ḥukmu li-llāhi l-ʿAliyyi l-Kabīr; wa ḥasbunā llāhu wa niʿma l-wakīl,
Truly we belong to Allāh, and truly to Him we return. Judgement belongs to Allāh, the Most High, the Great; and Allāh suffices us — an excellent guardian,
وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَىٰ رَسُوْلِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ أَجْمَعِيْنَ، سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوْنَ،
wa ṣallā llāhu wa sallama ʿalā rasūlinā Muḥammadin wa ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi ajmaʿīn. Subḥāna Rabbika Rabbi l-ʿizzati ʿammā yaṣifūn,
and may Allāh bless and grant peace to our Messenger Muḥammad and all his family and Companions. Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they describe,

وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ، وَالْحَمْدُ للّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ .رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا، وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا وَاهْدِنَا وَاسْقِنَا وَاصْلِحْ شَأْنَنَا وَشَأْنَ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ، بِحُرْمَةِ مَنْ أَنْزَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ سُوْرَةَ الْفَاتِحَةَ

wa salāmun ʿalā l-mursalīn, wa l-ḥamdu li-llāhi Rabbi l-ʿālamīn. Rabbanā taqabbal minnā, wa ʿfu ʿannā wa ghfir lanā wa rḥamnā wa tub ʿalaynā wa hdinā wa sqinā wa aṣliḥ shaʾnanā wa shaʾna l-muslimīn — bi-ḥurmati man anzalta ʿalayhi Sūrata l-Fātiḥah.

and peace be upon the messengers, and praise be to Allāh, Lord of the worlds. Our Lord, accept from us; pardon us, forgive us, have mercy on us, turn to us, guide us, give us rain, and set right our affair and the affair of the Muslims — by the sanctity of him upon whom You sent down Sūrat al-Fātiḥa.
Duʿāʾ al-Shaykh Nāẓim — 42 bands.
